answer: Hardware enclave attestation counters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to sign challenges from an epoch beacon using secure silicon. Because keys are fused into hardware, an adversary incurs the capital cost of buying distinct physical chips per identity. When a key is compromised, a revocation ripple instantly invalidates the entire plume of identities derived from that enclave. However, this approach anchors trust in centralized hardware vendors and remains vulnerable to side-channel key extraction.
